title: 6mA Labeling and HMW DNA Extraction from Fresh Frozen Human Brain Samples
author: Jonas Demeulemeester
materials: Continue with Circulomics CBB Tissue protocol from step 8 onwards. Continue with NEB Monarch HMW.

steps.title: Prepare Equipment
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary equipment for tissue processing.

substeps.instruction: Place the Dounce homogenizer and pestles on ice.
Chill the centrifuge to 4 °C.
Preheat the ThermoMixer to 37 °C.

steps.title: Tissue Transfer and Thawing
steps.instruction: Transfer tissue biopsies to the homogenizer and initiate thawing.

substeps.instruction: Carefully transfer 3-4 (2 mm diameter) tissue punch biopsies (~25 mg) to the chilled Dounce homogenizer.
Keep the Dounce homogenizer on ice during the entire disruption process.
Add 500 µL of 1X Lysis buffer and let the tissue thaw for 00:01:00.

steps.title: Tissue Homogenization
steps.instruction: Homogenize the tissue using Dounce pestles.

substeps.instruction: Gently homogenize the tissue 10X with pestle A and 10X with pestle B.

Push the tissue firmly into the bottom of the Dounce chamber with each stroke (Down + Up = 1X), keeping the tissue between the tip of the pestle and the bottom of the chamber for thorough homogenization.
If foam forms, transfer it in the subsequent step.

steps.title: Wash and Pellet Homogenate
steps.instruction: Wash the lysate and pellet the homogenate via centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Incubate on ice for 00:05:00.
Add 1000 µL of 1X Wash buffer.
Transfer the lysate to a 2 mL Protein LoBind microcentrifuge tube.
Rinse the pestles and homogenizer with the remaining 500 µL 1X Wash buffer and add to the sample.
Pellet homogenate by centrifuging at 700 x g and 4 °C for 00:05:00, then discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Hia5 Labeling
steps.instruction: Label the DNA using Hia5 labeling buffer.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 200 µL of 1X Hia5 labeling buffer using a 1 mL or wide bore tip.
Incubate on a ThermoMixer at 37 °C and 900 rpm for 00:30:00.

steps.title: HMW DNA Library Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the genomic DNA library following the ONT Ligation protocol (SQK-LSK110) with specific modifications.

substeps.instruction: Start with 3 µg - 4 µg of HMW DNA in 150 uL and shear 25x with a 26G needle or in Megaruptor to 35kb.
Adjust volumes for end-prep and FFPE repair steps accordingly (vol x 3) and omit the control strand (CS).
Extend end-prep and FFPE repair steps from 00:05:00 to 00:30:00 (30 min at 20 °C and 30 min at 65 °C).
Extend the ligation step to 01:00:00 at Room temperature.
Elute the AMPure cleanups for 00:10:00 and 00:20:00 after the end-prep and ligation steps.

steps.title: Library Loading
steps.instruction: Load the resulting library onto the sequencer.

substeps.instruction: Aim to load near the high end of the 5-50fmol range, typically ~8 µL (expected ~3x library yield; typical library prep yield is 30-50%).
Note: The amount loaded can be reduced during subsequent flushes to balance seq yield with the number of flushes.
